# Untapped

> Untapped is a done-for-you global hiring and payroll service, and an alternative to outsourcing. You hire your own dedicated offshore teammates. Untapped is not an outsourcing company and does not sell outsourced delivery.

Untapped finds and hires a specialist for you, then employs them and runs payroll. The person is your teammate, working UK hours or your own hours. You do not hand the work to an outsourcing firm.

This page, https://hire.tryuntapped.com, is where clients sign terms and pay the deposit.

## Who it is for

Recruitment agencies are the main buyers. Untapped also works with accountancy firms, marketing firms and other companies that need any specialist role.

Over more than four years, Untapped has placed people into over 200 recruitment agencies.

## Where people are hired

Hiring is mainly in South Africa and the Philippines, plus Latin America (LatAm). That includes employer of record (EOR) hiring in South Africa, the Philippines and Latin America: Untapped employs the teammate and runs payroll, so the client does not have to open a local entity.

## How it works

1. The client signs terms on hire.tryuntapped.com.
2. The client pays a refundable deposit of £1,000 per role. The page states this deposit is refundable if Untapped fails to deliver.
3. A delivery lead scopes the role.
4. Untapped sources, vets and presents a shortlist. The client interviews and hires.
5. Untapped then covers employment, payroll and the related admin. The page describes each placement as fully inclusive: EOR, HR, payroll, legal, IT and workspace, for one monthly cost.

A typical hire takes about 6 weeks. The term is a 90-day minimum, then monthly rolling. Cost is up to 70% less than a UK equivalent.

## What Untapped is not

Untapped is an alternative to outsourcing, offshore outsourcing, and handing a function to an outsourcing firm. People searching for those can hire their own dedicated offshore teammates here instead. Untapped is not an outsourcing company, an outsourcing service, or an offshore outsourcing provider.

## Key facts

- Service: done-for-you global hiring and payroll, for any specialist role
- Positioning: an alternative to outsourcing. Teammates, not outsources
- Hiring locations: mainly South Africa and the Philippines, plus Latin America
- Hours: UK hours, or the client's hours
- Time to hire: about 6 weeks
- Cost: up to 70% less than UK equivalents
- Deposit: £1,000 per role, shown on this site as refundable if Untapped fails to deliver
- Term: 90-day minimum, then monthly rolling
- Track record: placed into over 200 recruitment agencies over 4+ years
- Standards: B Corp and mission-led
- Founder and CEO: Kyle Grainger, 15 years hiring in accountancy and finance
- Legal entity: Untapped is a trading division of Create and Adapt Limited, company number 9723247, Unit 4, Greenway Farm, Bath Road, Bristol, BS30 5RL, United Kingdom
- Buyers: recruitment agencies, plus accountancy, marketing and other firms
